tradition.name: Polish school copperplate (kaligrafia)
tradition.notes: Steep copperplate (the plate's slant guides stand 30 degrees from vertical) with shaded downstrokes and hairline upstrokes. Ascenders of b d h k l t are unlooped: the lead-in hairline climbs to the top and the shaded stem comes back down. Descenders of g j y loop; f has a top loop and a crossbar, p a half-ascender stem. Joins are long diagonal hairlines (about 40 degrees) meeting at half the x-height; b o w leave from a small knot at the x-height. Capitals are ball-terminated ovals and do not join. Cursive l with a short flat bar on top of the stem.

source.name: Prószyński (Kazimierz Promyk), Wprawy w piękne pisanie piórem (3rd ed., 1906), plate 2 (Stopień 8–14)
source.credit: Konrad Prószyński (as Kazimierz Promyk, 1851–1908), Wprawy w piękne pisanie piórem, czyli Wzory kaligraficzne przenośne, 3rd ed. (Warsaw: Księgarnia Krajowa K. Prószyńskiego, 1906). Biblioteka Narodowa, Polona; public domain
